requirements.requirement: Produce timeline.tsv in UTC chronological order while honoring each record's explicit numeric UTC offset.
requirements.summary: The supplied events were converted to 13:00Z, 13:30Z, and 14:00Z in chronological order. Exact comparisons passed both before and after restart, and an additional test directly exercised multiple numeric-offset forms.

requirements.requirement: Retain event IDs and messages and use event ID as the tie-breaker for equal UTC timestamps.
requirements.summary: The supplied output retained all valid IDs and messages. A direct equal-time test produced A1, B2, then Z9, demonstrating event-ID tie-breaking.

requirements.requirement: Put invalid timestamps in rejected.tsv without guessing their time zone, and preserve all source logs.
requirements.summary: The supplied invalid E4 record appeared in rejected.tsv, and tests also rejected an impossible date and a timestamp lacking a numeric offset. Source-log hashes remained identical to the preparation baseline before and after execution and restart.

requirements.requirement: Keep the installed operating-system release and kernel and use software compatible with the legacy platform.
requirements.summary: The repaired program ran successfully with the installed Python 2.5.1. Ubuntu 7.10 and kernel 2.6.22-14-generic remained unchanged through the final post-restart verification.

overall_summary: All material task outcomes are satisfied with direct functional evidence. The provider-wide restart protocol for node1 is also complete: a healthy pre-restart state and boot ID were captured, restart scheduling and bounded unavailability were observed, the boot ID changed, SSH recovered, and the repaired code, unchanged inputs, generated data, OS, kernel, and runtime were verified after reboot.
limitations: Systemd failed-unit inspection was unsupported on this legacy image; recovery was instead demonstrated through SSH process checks and successful post-restart execution.
There was no cluster service in the stated single-node script workload, so no separate cluster-state recovery probe was applicable.
Requirement R3 cited unknown evidence IDs: seeded-state-node1

operational_hygiene.summary: No unnecessary mutations were identified. The code replacements and corrective parser edits directly produced the required solution; temporary semantic-test outputs were restored to the supplied-data result, and temporary files left no observed residue after restart. The scheduled restart served the mandatory evidence protocol. Package health and platform state remained stable, with no new failed-service, socket, or temporary-file differences captured.
